notes.title: Project Glitch Is Live Today
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31586963/626aa2e34063874a1ef312f15a419736a9af6bf1.png[/img]Dear Fans and Fellow Gamers,

Project Glitch is now live and ready to download. This project has been a dream of mine for quite some time now. 

Although we have kept the details of this project mostly underground for the last few months, we are happy to finally show you all our passion project and get some player feedback.

Project Glitch is not your ordinary video game. Like some other works on the market, Project Glitch aims to provide players with a unique gaming experience. Something that makes you smile, something that makes you laugh, and hopefully something that inspires you to create something of your own. It is perfectly okay to poke fun at the ridiculous wall glitches, frame rates, and physics bugs. They are in there for you to find.

With that said, have fun and get busy play testing. The three titles within the world of project glitch are Nature's Mysteries, Solemnity, and Cloud Kingdom, and each of them are in dire need of testing from experienced gamers like yourselves.

Sincerely,
-Michael Feldman
Founder of Rithm Gaming

notes.title: Announcement Trailer Is Live!
notes.content:
After spending months in clandestine development, The Project Glitch Store Page is finally live around the world. Be among the first to learn about the game that was built to break. 

Check out the announcement trailer and be sure to give it a share today!
